description: I'm a passionate B.E. student in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) at KIT'S College Of Engineering, Kolhapur. I specialize in the MERN stack, real-time communication technologies, and scalable backend design.

With a strong foundation in Data Structures and Algorithms (solving 200+ LeetCode problems) and hands-on experience building projects like Connectify, Wanderlust, and MarketPulse, I love transforming complex ideas into high-performance, user-centric web applications.
